the_rule.VALUE_PRESERVING: declares in the contract the exact value the builder already uses (e.g. 0.48 - 0.10*smoothing moves from shader literal to family definition, unchanged). The render is bit-identical; NOTHING is voided. PROOF REQUIRED: re-render the fixture frames and assert bit-identity against pre-repair frames — a repair that claims to change nothing must demonstrate it changed nothing.
the_rule.VALUE_MOVING: changes what the renderer does (plumbing a dead parameter; changing the marble coefficient form to genuinely chromatic). Voids every verdict resting on the touched families — the void list is attached to every value-moving item BEFORE it is executed.

sequencing: value-preserving half FIRST, as one block, with the bit-identity proof

value-moving half by blast radius, MOSTLY DEFERRED: marble coefficients are free (MARBLED holds no PASS; its FAIL is already a FAIL); edge_profile is the opposite extreme (dead in all nine families — plumbing voids every M6 verdict at once, deferred); the 49 dead are MARKED and DECLARED (costless) with plumbing deferred to nodes that genuinely need each one, one family at a time, paying the re-run knowingly
classification_requirement: each of the 25 under-declared and each of the 49 dead classified value-preserving or value-moving, with void lists, IN the node record before execution
blocked_lift_condition: PRODUCT_REALIZATION_BLOCKED lifts on the value-preserving half plus the marking — the products need a contract that says what it means, not a contract where every dead parameter has been plumbed
